title: Today tab, round 3: four stages, problems as markers

steps.headline: Your four stages replace the situation labels; sections are the stages.
steps.changed: Every piece of work is in one of four stages: Planning, Agentic buildout, Human polish & review, Merged. Today opens on Start here, then "Human polish & review" (8). "Needs your look", "Ready to merge", "Idle" and "No finish line" are gone; there is no "Your turn" marker.
steps.notice: Inside a stage's own section, rows don't repeat the stage label: the heading says it. Start here and the Paused list (which mixes stages) still show it.
steps.risk: Nothing is Merged in this Oct 12 snapshot, so there is no Merged section yet; merged work shows in "Since the last release".

steps.headline: In your stage, the filled button is the next step: review, merge, or go back to the chat.
steps.changed: Sync safety (reviewed, checks pass) offers Merge to master. Project skills (deck unanswered) offers Open review deck. Rows a chat is on now offer Go to chat. Everything else offers Resume latest chat. Hovering the button says why it is that one.
steps.notice: Problems sit beside the name as separate markers: Not backed up (amber), Checks failing (red), Working (live).

steps.headline: Agentic buildout: what chats are building, with problems marked.
steps.changed: Seven pieces of work. Sync retry shows the red Checks failing marker and offers Fix failing checks; Helper agents and Bundled skill content show Not backed up.

steps.headline: Planning and Paused are folded below; paused work keeps its stage and its reason.
steps.changed: Planning (1): Offline use. Paused (1): OneDrive, which shows its stage (Agentic buildout), Checks failing and Paused, with "Paused because: known regressions…" and an Unpause button.
steps.notice: Tidy up, Bugs and Since the last release are unchanged.
